text: چلم چوکھا—نہ جیوݨ دی آس—نہ مرن دا دھوکھا۔
romanized: Chilam chokhā—na jīwan dī ās—na maran dā dhokhā.
literal_en: An overflowing pipe—neither desire of life nor fear of death.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
